description: Procedure for correcting errors on an existing CNIC (e.g. name, date of birth, address)
application_location: Nearest NADRA Registration Center or NADRA's online NADIS portal
required_documents: Correction application form (available at the NADRA center)
Supporting proof of the correction (e.g. Matric certificate, Form-B, or utility bill)
steps: Visit the nearest NADRA Registration Center or use the online NADIS portal
Fill the correction application form and attach the supporting proof document
Provide biometrics/photo if required and pay the official fee
Collect the corrected card after the standard processing time
fee: Approx. Rs. 500 (normal), Rs. 1500 (urgent) - verify current fee at official NADRA office
processing_time: 7-15 working days (normal), 3-5 days (urgent) - verify current timing at official office
important_note: Verify exact fees and required documents at the official NADRA center before applying.

description: Procedure for registering a First Information Report (FIR) for a crime or incident
application_location: Nearest Police Station having jurisdiction over the location of the incident
required_documents: Any evidence related to the incident (photos, documents, witnesses, if available)
Written or verbal statement of the incident
steps: Go to the police station that has jurisdiction over where the incident happened
Give your statement to the Duty Officer describing the incident in detail
Ask for a copy of the registered FIR with the FIR number for your records
If the police refuse to register the FIR, you can approach the relevant SP office or use the provincial police complaint portal
fee: No fee - FIR registration is free of cost
processing_time: Should be registered immediately upon report - verify with the relevant provincial police portal if delayed
important_note: FIR registration is a legal right and free of cost. If refused, escalate to a senior police officer or the provincial citizen portal.

description: Procedure for obtaining a new Domicile Certificate
application_location: Nearest E-Khidmat Center or AC Office
required_documents: Copy of applicant's CNIC / Form B
steps: Obtain application form from E-Khidmat center or website
Attach all required documents
Pay official fee challan
Provide biometrics and photo at center
Collect certificate after processing days
important_note: Verify exact fees at the official center.

department: Union Council / Local Government (via NADRA Child Registration)
description: Procedure for registering a birth and obtaining a Birth Certificate / Child Registration Certificate (CRC)
application_location: Nearest Union Council office or NADRA Registration Center
required_documents: Hospital birth notification / discharge slip (if available)
Marriage certificate of parents (Nikah Nama), if requested
steps: Visit the Union Council office or NADRA center within the required registration period
Fill the birth registration form with the child's and parents' details
Submit required documents and pay the official fee
Collect the Birth Certificate / Child Registration Certificate (B-Form) after processing
fee: Approx. Rs. 50-200 depending on registration timing - verify current fee at Union Council office
processing_time: Same day to a few working days, depending on office - verify locally
important_note: Registering within 30 days of birth is usually free or low-cost in many Union Councils; delayed registration may cost more - verify locally.

department: Board of Revenue / Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA)
description: Procedure for obtaining a Fard (record of land ownership/rights)
application_location: Nearest Arazi Record Center (Punjab) or respective provincial Board of Revenue office
required_documents: Khewat/Khasra number or property details, if known
Application form (available at the Arazi Record Center)
steps: Visit the nearest Arazi Record Center or use the provincial online land record portal, where available
Provide the property details (Khewat/Khasra number, mouza/village name) and your CNIC
Pay the official fee for issuance of the Fard
Collect the Fard, which may be issued same-day at computerized centers
fee: Approx. Rs. 100-500 depending on province and record type - verify current fee at the official center
processing_time: Often same-day at computerized Arazi Record Centers - verify locally
important_note: Verify the exact office and fee for your province, as land record systems differ between provinces.
